diagnosis: The endpoint downloads and transforms industrial sensor telemetry batches from storage using req.params.batchId without checking whether the requesting user's organization owns the manufacturing facility or sensors. Any authenticated tenant can enumerate and download environmental sensor metrics belonging to other facilities.
exploit_request:
GET /iot/telemetry/batches/batch_wh_east_88192/download HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.warehouse.internal:7788
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_engineer_jwt>
Accept: application/x-ndjson
